retrieval_policy: Official/primary sources first; snapshots are frozen on first successful acquisition and reused for deterministic reruns.

source_receipts.claim: The current official product page separately lists スプリントスピード and 最速タイム（一塁到達） under batter tracking data.
source_receipts.construct_role: current direct/near-direct physical speed; Sprint Speed and H2F remain distinct
source_receipts.source_locator: HTML headings/list around player tracking fields; terms スプリントスピード and 最速タイム（一塁到達)

source_receipts.claim: MLB defines 90-foot splits in five-foot cumulative increments and standardizes home-to-first to 90 feet; raw H2F geometry differs by batting side.
source_receipts.construct_role: initial acceleration shape plus standardized end-to-end running context
source_receipts.source_locator: Definition section: five-foot increments, bat-on-ball to first, 90-foot extrapolation

source_receipts.claim: MLB separates Outfielder Jump into Reaction (first 1.5 seconds), Burst (second 1.5 seconds) and Route (directional efficiency over three seconds).
source_receipts.construct_role: defensive-context burst/acceleration only; not universal speed
source_receipts.source_locator: Definition and component bullets for Reaction, Burst and Route

source_receipts.claim: Lead Distance measures runner distance from the base at the pitcher's first movement and is separate from maximum speed/acceleration and throwing variables.
source_receipts.construct_role: stealing/start technique context; never a physical-speed booster
source_receipts.source_locator: Definition and explanatory paragraph on leads versus maximum speed/acceleration

source_receipts.claim: The official leaderboard defines basestealing opportunity/value and exposes Lead Distance Gained between pitcher first move and pitch release.
source_receipts.construct_role: stealing technique/opportunity context; outcome proxy, not physical ground truth
source_receipts.source_locator: Leaderboard explanation around basestealing impact, Lead Distance Gained and qualifiers

source_receipts.claim: The official Sprint Speed leaderboard exposes Competitive Runs, Bolts, HP to 1B and Sprint Speed; Bolt is a cumulative >=30 ft/s run.
source_receipts.construct_role: top-speed value plus reliability/exposure and end-to-end context
source_receipts.source_locator: Rendered table header and Sprint Speed/Bolt explanation

source_receipts.claim: 1.02 defines Spd as the average of four capped components: stolen-base success, attempt frequency, triple rate and run rate.
source_receipts.construct_role: mixed outcome proxy with technique/opportunity overlap; never direct physical evidence

source_receipts.claim: Official WBC Statcast search states pitch-level data begins in 2023 and the public player selector contains 2023 and 2026 Japan entries; the public result field surface exposes pitch/hitting/fielding/glossary context but no player-level Sprint Speed, 90-foot or H2F result column.
source_receipts.construct_role: potential cross-league bridge; running-value acquisition currently bounded/blocked on public surface
source_receipts.source_locator: World Baseball Classic Statcast Search description, season/player selectors and running glossary section

source_receipts.claim: MLB states full Statcast tracking is available for WBC games, searchable for 2023 and available for the 2026 Classic.
source_receipts.construct_role: tracking-scope confirmation only; does not prove running metric retrievability
source_receipts.source_locator: Article paragraph describing full Statcast tracking and searchable 2023/2026 availability

source_receipts.claim: MLB Pipeline prospect material exposes a 20-80 Run scouting component separately from the other tools.
source_receipts.construct_role: historical scouting context, year/age stamped; not direct measurement
source_receipts.source_locator: Prospect tools/Run field in the page snapshot; coverage is page-specific

wbc_coverage.interpretation: The denominator is the official WBC player-selector lower bound, not a claim that all tournament participants are listed. Zero running rows is an acquisition limitation, never a slow/zero inference.

required_negative_findings.scope: public Baseball Savant WBC search surface checked for 2023 and 2026 Japan selector universe
required_negative_findings.result: No player-level Sprint Speed/90ft/H2F result rows were retrievable from the checked public search surface.
required_negative_findings.guard: Do not interpret zero rows as zero speed; preserve the official tracking-scope positive finding separately.

required_negative_findings.result: Current official field availability does not validate old local values; old values remain fail-closed under the local provenance ruling.
